# Robots.txt for Gramin Aarogya Sathi (Rural Digital Health Mission)
# Allows Googlebot and search engines to index public citizen health tools
# Restricts administrative and hospital command centers under healthcare security compliance

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /remedies
Allow: /emergency
Allow: /triage
Allow: /teleconsult

# Protect administrative, medical command, and internal API surfaces
Disallow: /developer-portal/
Disallow: /hospital-portal/
Disallow: /hosp-portal/
Disallow: /api/

# Googlebot specific directives
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /developer-portal/
Disallow: /hospital-portal/
Disallow: /api/

# Sitemap location for Google Search Console indexing
Sitemap: https://graminaarogya.gov.in/sitemap.xml
